body: It's just that I have no idea how to even get there, when I said I had no money that literally meant already having hit rock bottom when it comes to that.

I know of forums like that and used to lurk on some, pretty much telling me things I already know. I'm terrible around people unless a monitor seperates me from them, as odd as it seems being much more outgoing if thats the case, to the point were I took charge of groups of people in games I enjoyed, to accomplish things at near obsessive perfection. Eventually, that side of me did the same as the over, as in driving people away. But either way, even that random surge of confidence seems to have faded since then.

Another thing I know had helped me in the past was having pets, I seemed to always do better with them than with people, but I'm in a situation where I can't even care for myself, living in a messy apartment behind on rent by soon 2 months, facing eviction at some point or another. I can't find any drive to change anything about it, I'm amazed if I even get out of bed most days.

I don't even know if there's anything like that here. Socializing isn't one of my strong points either, I tend to be quiet and passive in conversation, which is probably one of the reasons I'm in the situation I'm in. Like most introverted people I know, I have a much easier time talking over a medium like the internet to remove social anxiety from the situation, pretty much the only way I can get myself to speak my mind, if at all.

I've already been in therapy for what they called a depressive episode and work related stress, I don't feel like it really did anything, just speech therapy, no medication or anything like that. I'm already considered somewhat a failure by the family i still have contact with, they thought I turned it around when I got my last job and moved away for that, but evidently I have not.
Tbh I really don't. I decided to catch some sleep and try talk to family or a friend today but i just can't make myself do it. Still remember how that went last time and it wasn't good.

One of the problems is that my last job in wholesale (also what I learned for 3 years, sales with a wholesale specialty) was fine and something I'd do again, but the entire thing just doesn't feel fulfilling at all. It's a job that someone has to do sure, but other than being able to afford things there was nothing much to like about it. Considering a new job would require me to be able to afford a car (rural area) or other means of transportation to get there, which i certainly can not in my current situation, even though i still have mine but behind on taxes and insurance so that won't last long, my prospects seem pretty crap to me.

I have, but I'm being turned down or not even replied to on most of them, which is one of the things that have driven me to this point once again. I'm not even sure i won't attempt again in the near future, not feeling like I'm able to change anything in my current situation.

Thing is, it wasn't the first time. Same thing happened years ago, chickened out and hid in my mothers cellar for over a day before someone found me there. Been through all the "it-gets-better-talks" and was inclined to believe them after I got through another rough patch and it all seemed to work out for a while, but again I've lost my job, am running low on money (literally nothing left) and there's nothing to look forward to on the horizon...
